component.name: Astrometrics
component.summary: View, process, and analyze astronomy images and control a telescope

description.p: Astrometrics is a desktop application for astrophotography, spectroscopy, and observatory control. It opens FITS images, controls telescope mounts, focusers, and cameras through INDI, and reads guiding from PHD2.

ul.li: A sky map and star catalog for finding and planning targets.
Star detection, plate solving, image stacking, and photometry.
Telescope mount, focuser, and camera control through INDI.
Several workspaces that can be spread across monitors, with a system tray icon that shows quick status.

description.p: Support for Ubuntu 26.04 on Wayland, AppStream metadata, a native file thumbnailer for FITS images, and a platform adapter design.
